wiki.title: Robert T. Reives II
wiki.extract: Robert Tyrone Reives II (born September 24, 1970) is an American politician from North Carolina. Originally an Attorney from Sanford, North Carolina, Reives was first appointed to the North Carolina House of Representatives in January 2014 and he has subsequently been re-elected 6 times, most recently in 2024. As a Democrat, he represents the 54th district which includes all of Chatham County and parts of Randolph County (formerly all of Chatham County and part of Lee County or Durham County). In December 2020, Reives was elected by his peers as the House Democratic leader.
